purpose: Determine whether a frozen, seed-robust functional complementarity objective creates a reproducible exact-versus-strong-classical optimization gap while preserving scaffold-holdout utility on both MK14 and PPARG.

objective.normalization: per-seed per-receptor empirical CDF fitted on the outer-train rows only

qubo_encoding_note.status: exact set-function screen before sparse auxiliary encoding
qubo_encoding_note.receptor_variables: x_i=1 iff receptor i is selected
qubo_encoding_note.active_auxiliaries: binary auxiliaries encode per-active per-seed single- and double-receptor support; additional threshold auxiliaries encode support in at least two or all three seeds
qubo_encoding_note.decoy_auxiliaries: binary auxiliaries encode whether a decoy is exposed by any selected receptor in any seed
qubo_encoding_note.constraints: all OR and cardinality-threshold relations are enforced by quadratic penalties with binary slack variables
qubo_encoding_note.next_step_if_supported: derive and audit the sparse auxiliary BQM without changing this set-function objective

classical_comparator.description: Retain the best 64 states at each forward cardinality, add every state on 16 singleton-start greedy paths, then run deterministic best-improvement add/drop/swap local search from every retained state.

support_gate.decision: Authorize Stage38 sparse auxiliary-QUBO encoding only if the exact objective beats the strong classical search in at least five of eight target-fold cells, has mean train gap at least 1e-6, and has nonnegative mean scaffold-holdout objective and BEDROC20 deltas on each target.

interpretation_boundary: Stage37 is post-hoc objective development using only frozen MK14 and PPARG training rows. Scaffold holdouts test transfer within those development sets but are not independent protein validation. A pass would support sparse auxiliary-QUBO construction, not quantum hardware, quantum advantage, new docking, or alteration of any prior failed confirmation gate. A failure freezes this objective as unsupported and forbids further weight tuning on these same outcomes.
